newsitem.title: USA: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME hog and pork belly futures ranged from 0.100 cent lower to 0.100 higher, livestock analysts said.
Some analsyts look for early resistance in hog futures on mostly steady to lower cash hog indications as packers cut back on kills to support cutout margins.

However, interior calls were mixed as some packers lifted bids to encourage larger hog runs and this could encourage carryover demand in futures. Hog numbers are also seen easing going into the week, they said.

A steady to weak product market may weigh on pork belly futures at the start. But most analysts look for carryover technical support and demand on expectations that cash prices will firm soon. Cash has turned up before at this price level, they said.
Expectations for few deliveries against the February contract on first notice day Monday should also lend support. The market appears to be expecting few, if any, deliveries, they said.
